purpose: Deep, slow, calm epic narration for the assembly film; an unhurried storyteller, not an announcer.
identity_source: Kokoro-82M built-in preset voice am_onyx. No real-person clone, and no conditioning prompt.

selection.method: chosen by ear from four speeds of one passage, then confirmed against three alternative engine chains
rejected_alternatives: speed 0.88 (v7.2's setting), 0.82, 0.74 of the same voice
the same clone plus restoration and the v7.2 condenser EQ

eq.note: High-pass only. The warm-natural five-band curve is profile-specific and was not copied; nothing else is applied to this voice without a measured reason.

notes: Kokoro takes no conditioning prompt, so the stored WAV is an identity reference for auditioning, not an input to generation. Reproduce the voice from voice + speed + seed, not from the file.
Seeding does not vary this engine much: takes of one line differ only in sampling noise, with identical durations. Cross-line register consistency is therefore inherent rather than selected for.
Chosen over a 3B cloning model whose output the listener ranked below this engine's raw output.
Film-specific placements, levels and takes live with the film, in video/showoff/assembly/audio/VOICE-LOG.md.
